# Snag

Lifehack cabinet. No account. The card stays on the device until a computer you leave on keeps the file.

Live: https://snag-hacks.vercel.app

## Agent filing

Open one URL per hack. The card rides in the hash. It is not stored on a server.

```
{origin}/inbox#card=BASE64URL
```

BASE64URL is UTF-8 JSON, base64url, no padding:

```
{
  "situation": "When …",
  "title": "short name",
  "steps": ["one action", "the next action"],
  "caveat": "",
  "tags": ["topic"],
  "source": { "kind": "agent", "label": "your name", "url": "https://the-page" }
}
```

`situation` starts with "When". Do not invent steps. Do not send the card anywhere else.

Source: https://github.com/emmi-dev12/snag
